prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity portrait mobile app CHILD HOME screen for Lumio, a premium educational adventure game ages 5–9. Not a website, not a collage, not a phone mockup: edge-to-edge flat screenshot, portrait ratio about 9:19.5. Reference 1 is approved Lumi mascot; use his exact purple flame-crown identity, cream eyes, plum outline, lavender belly and golden tail in a freshly posed small welcoming guide illustration. Reference 2 is approved lowercase lumio wordmark, reproduce it as a small top-left brand signature.
ART DIRECTION: polished delightful modern 2D cartoon adventure, custom illustrated floating learning islands with clean shapes and subtle flat depth; thoughtful whitespace, clear hierarchy, bold simple readable rounded sans text, chunky controls with restrained bottom-edge depth. Avoid generic dashboard cards, glossy 3D, photorealism, busy confetti, childish rainbow overload or cloning other apps. Colors: #7651D6 main violet, #FFD34E gold, #20C8C4 turquoise, #65E1D6 aqua, #B8A0F2 lilac, #FFF4D9 cream, #38234F text, white cards.
LAYOUT FROM TOP TO BOTTOM:
1. Minimal top safe area then small lumio wordmark left; right compact earned-star pill with simple gold star and exact "24", then small round child avatar.
2. Clear headline "Ready to explore, Afiq?" in dark plum, smaller line "A little discovery every day." Lumi waves beside headline area, no huge separate hero card.
3. Slim soft cream progress strip, label "Today’s adventure" left, "1 of 3" right, three large dots one filled purple and two empty. Calm progress, no timer or streak.
4. Main focus: generous illustrated turquoise sky/world-map area occupying middle 45% of screen, with one featured floating island called "Number Kingdom": friendly rounded miniature castle, geometric trees and a winding stepping-stone path to three clear level nodes. One complete node has check, one current node is prominently purple with play triangle, one future node simple hollow circle. One small side island preview with book and trees below left. Do NOT crowd scene with unreadable signs. World title "Number Kingdom" appears clearly above map; small subtitle "Count, match and discover". Lumi may only appear once total.
5. Prominent wide violet primary button with white text "Play next adventure" and white play icon, below map on cream area. Smaller centered "About 5 minutes" text.
6. A small readable "Explore worlds" text link with arrow, then fixed bottom navigation on white, 3 simple icon+label items "Adventure" selected purple, "Discover", "My stars". Clear generous hit regions. Keep all content inside screen, no clipped nav or overflowing text. No purchase banners, no ads, no hearts/lives, no competitive leaderboard. Parent access via a small discrete labeled "Parents" icon near avatar/top, not main CTA.
Text exact and sparse, carefully aligned, typography clear at mobile size, use solid dark text on pale backgrounds. NO outer device, design annotations, titles outside app, watermarks or multiple screens.

Create ONE portrait mobile UI screenshot for Lumio, matching reference 1 HOME screen visual system: cream background, plum readable rounded typography, violet chunky rounded buttons, turquoise accents, clean polished 2D game art. Reference 2 is approved Lumi identity, preserve it. Screen is a calm focused beginner COUNTING GAME, no home map and no bottom navigation, no phone frame or external annotations. Portrait aspect about 9:19.5.
From top: a large simple close X at left, progress bar with 3 of 5 segments filled purple and two pale, small speaker toggle at right. Under bar centered text "Number Kingdom" and small "Counting to 5". Question heading large and exact "How many stars?" with smaller instruction "Tap each star to count."
Large spacious central cream/white rounded activity panel with EXACTLY FIVE simple flat golden five-point stars with dark plum outlines, arranged two on top row and three on bottom row, all equal size and separated. No other star anywhere on this game screen to confuse counting. Plenty of whitespace. A small purple tap indicator near one star but no number labels.
Below activity area one row of THREE large rounded square answer buttons, exact labels "4" "5" "6", dark plum on white with purple outlines and a subtle bottom lip. Middle answer "5" is selected with pale lilac fill and clear thicker violet border. No green/red or correctness indicator yet.
Below answers, one small friendly Lumi in THINKING pose with hand beneath chin beside a short speech bubble "Take your time." His face and gold flame tail visible, friendly not judging. Mascot takes under 15% screen height.
At bottom anchored above safe area one wide violet action button with white exact label "Check answer". Under it small readable "Need a hint?" text action. Strong whitespace, question and countable stars are main focus. All screen elements fit. Header and controls large readable on phone. No reward counters, no timers, no lives, no competing CTAs, no confetti or background stars. High-quality finished UI visual concept, one screen only.

Create ONE portrait mobile app ACTIVITY COMPLETE screen for Lumio, matching attached reference 1 home UI and reference 2 approved mascot. Edge-to-edge screenshot ratio 9:19.5, no phone frame, no collage. Premium rounded 2D educational adventure aesthetic: cream background, #7651D6 violet buttons, plum typography, gold rewards, turquoise accent, tidy white cards, restrained bottom-edge button depth.
Top safe area with unobtrusive close X at right. Small centered eyebrow label "NUMBER KINGDOM". Large centered heading "You did it, Afiq!" and subheading "You practised counting to 5."
Hero occupying upper middle: approved Lumi in a NEW celebrating pose, arms lifted, eyes closed into happy crescents, joyful open smile, recognizable swept purple crown, lavender belly and golden flame tail. A few big sparse flat confetti shapes and a soft pale lilac circular backdrop, never a noisy spray. Character centered, fully visible, enough breathing room.
Below hero a single reward strip with three gold star symbols and exact "+3 stars", readable dark plum; optional tiny line "New total: 27". No coins or competing economy.
Then one calm white rounded progress card with heading "Today’s adventure", right label "2 of 3", three equal dots of which exactly two purple filled and one outline. Beneath, small encouraging text "One more discovery when you’re ready."
Bottom actions: wide violet primary button with white text "Back to map". Below it a clear wide secondary white outlined button with plum text "Take a break". Both large enough for children. One small tertiary text link "Play again" if room. No countdown, no automatic next lesson, no streak threat, no shame, no upsell. No bottom navigation on this transient screen. Balanced vertical composition, concise large legible text, important actions above bottom safe area. Professional polished game UI, no external labels or annotations. Preserve mascot identity and keep gold flame distinct from reward stars.

Create ONE high-fidelity portrait MOBILE PARENT DASHBOARD screen for Lumio educational app. Reference 1 establishes child app branding; reference 2 is approved wordmark. Same product but calmer adult-facing visual treatment. One edge-to-edge screenshot, portrait 9:19.5, no phone frame, no collage or surrounding annotations. White and faint lilac #F4F0FC surfaces, deep plum #38234F text, restrained violet #7651D6 accents, simple medium-weight rounded sans; less puffy than child headings. No fantasy world illustration or giant mascot, very subtle icons and tidy cards, generous whitespace.
At top small lumio wordmark left and discreet "Parent space" label. Profile selector row with small child avatar, "Afiq" and smaller "Age 7", dropdown chevron; right settings gear. Below large "A little progress, every day" headline and period selector "This week" with chevron. A small unobtrusive pill "Sample data" near selector because all shown values are demonstration.
Three compact summary cards in one row, exact values and labels: "35 min" / "Learning time"; "7" / "Activities"; "4" / "Days explored". No charts, graphs, misleading percentages or medical/development claims.
Section "Learning snapshot" with three clean rows: simple number icon, "Mathematics", status "Growing confidence"; book icon, "English", status "Exploring"; speech icon, "Bahasa Melayu", status "Exploring". Include readable status words, not color alone.
One pale lavender insight card headed "A strength to celebrate", text "Counting objects up to 5", small supportive line "Try counting together at home." Small gold accent icon.
One white purple-outlined suggestion card headed "Practise next", text "Matching numbers to groups", simple arrow right. No red failure styling, no diagnosis or child ranking.
Section "Your family settings" with three spacious list rows: "Learning goal" right value "10 min / day"; "Sound & motion" chevron; "Manage child profiles" chevron. Values are illustrative only. A simple wide violet button "Return to child mode". Fixed bottom nav with four icon+label items "Overview" selected violet, "Progress", "Profiles", "Settings". All content fits portrait screen with safe area. Rounded corners, restrained shadows, crisp legible text, accessible visual contrast intention. No child upselling, leaderboard, currency, purchase banner or notification urgency. Exact text, professional premium app concept.
